## What this is

A community-maintained dataset of startup credits, cloud and AI credits, SaaS
perks and founder discounts. Every record carries the vendor's own page as its
source, a short quoted span of the text that supports it, and the date a human
last confirmed it.

Two things make it different from the lists that came before:

1. **Eligibility is structured, not prose.** Funding floors and ceilings, partner
   gates, company-age limits and region rules are typed fields, so you can filter
   for what you can actually get.
2. **Nothing is inferred into permission.** An unknown is recorded as unknown and
   excluded from every "you qualify" view.

**Most credits do not require an accelerator.** That is the most common piece of
misinformation in this space, and the [44 programs here that need no partner
or accelerator](collections/no-partner-required.md) are the correction.

## How to read an entry

Eligibility tags come **before** the credit amount, deliberately. Knowing you
qualify for $5,000 is worth more than seeing a $350,000 headline you cannot reach.

| Tag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `🟢 no partner needed` | The vendor states no accelerator, VC or partner referral is required |
| `🤝 partner required` / `improves offer` / `gates higher tiers` | A partner relationship changes or controls access |
| `💡 no funding needed` | The vendor states you need not have raised |
| `💰 VC-backed only` | Institutional funding is a stated condition |
| `🥾 bootstrapped OK` | The page affirmatively says self-funded companies qualify |
| `📞 sales call` | No self-serve path; a call is required |
| `🆕 new customers only` | Existing or prior customers are excluded — a top rejection cause |
| `🌍 region limits` | The vendor names excluded countries or regions |
| `✅ verified` | A human opened the official page and confirmed the claim |
| `➖ partly verified` | Official info was read, but some detail could not be inspected |
| `⚠️ needs manual check` | The page is blocked or gated; **no amount is published** |

Absence of a tag means **unknown**, never "no restriction".

## Find credits for your startup

This repository answers **"What startup credits exist?"**

StartupFlow AI answers **"Which credits, accelerators, grants, investors and programs do I qualify for?"**

This list tells you what exists. Filtering it against your own situation -- country, stage, funding, accelerator -- is what StartupFlow AI does.

**[Match my startup → StartupFlow AI](https://startupflowai.com/tools/eligibility-quiz?utm_source=github&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=free-startup-credits&utm_content=matching)**

## Data and API

**`data/` is the source of truth. Everything else you can read is generated from
it** — this README, the category pages, the per-program pages and the API files.
That is why an amount can never say one thing here and another in the JSON.

| Path | What it is | Edit it? |
|---|---|---|
| [`data/programs/`](data/programs/) | **One YAML file per program.** The dataset. | ✅ **Yes — this is the only place to edit** |
| [`data/categories.yml`](data/categories.yml) · [`regions.yml`](data/regions.yml) · [`collections.yml`](data/collections.yml) | Taxonomy and the browse filters | ✅ Yes |
| [`programs/`](programs/) | A readable page per program: eligibility, evidence, sources | ❌ Generated |
| [`categories/`](categories/) · [`collections/`](collections/) | Browse views | ❌ Generated |
| [`api/programs.json`](api/programs.json) · [`.csv`](api/programs.csv) · [`index.json`](api/index.json) | The dataset for machines | ❌ Generated |
| [`schema/`](schema/) | JSON Schema for one record — powers editor autocomplete | ❌ Generated |
| [`scripts/`](scripts/) · [`templates/`](templates/) | The generator and the checks CI runs | Only to change how pages render |
| [`docs/`](docs/) | [Verification policy](docs/verification-policy.md) · [what runs automatically](docs/automation.md) · [measured link rot](docs/audits/) | — |

Records are CC BY 4.0. If you build something on this, attribution is all we ask.

## Verification policy

96 verified · 1 partially verified · 11 need manual verification

Re-verification runs on a **180-day cycle**. `last_verified` is only ever
set by a human who opened the page; a separate `last_checked` records automated
link checks. A bot fetching a URL is not a human confirming that an offer still
exists on those terms.

Read the full policy: [docs/verification-policy.md](docs/verification-policy.md) ·
See it measured: [docs/audits/2026-09-link-rot.md](docs/audits/2026-09-link-rot.md)

## Contributing

Add or correct one program by editing a single file in
[`data/programs/`](data/programs/). Two contributors adding two programs never
conflict.

The fastest way to help is to **report something that is wrong**. A founder who
just got rejected is the best rot signal this project has.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
